caption: The drawing features a repeating floral motif, primarily composed of three large stylized flowers with red petals, yellow centers, and white petal-like shapes bordering the centers. Each flower has a green stem and two elongated green leaves with lighter green central veins, and a smaller red circular flower at the base. The composition repeats at a diagonal orientation, with three main clusters of flowers visible, one in each of the lower left, upper left, and lower right sections of the page, partially cropped at the edges. The flowers are spaced so that their stems and leaves point towards the center of the page. Overlaid near the top center is a square inset containing a monochrome grid pattern of diagonally-oriented squares, each with a small black and white line-drawn floral motif resembling the colored flowers in the main design. The background is a plain off-white, and there are faint construction lines throughout the page, indicating the structure for repeating the pattern.
title: Quilt
